notes_en: At Shichahai–Yuhe, morning: the water gates carry the memory of grain tribute barges. What arrives, what leaves, where transfer occurs, what changes.

title_en: When the past grows new life
notes_en: Gamla Skogsby, Iron Age site: soil, plants and food are being used to ask whether the past can generate future life.
